name: WeCan
description: Comprehensive, AI-powered career accelerator and interview platform for students and software engineers.

problem_statement.title: AI-Powered Technical Interview & Placement Acceleration Platform
problem_statement.domain: Education, Career Technology, and Automated Technical Evaluation
problem_statement.solution: WeCan unifies the entire technical job preparation lifecycle: real-time voice-first mock interviews (STAR method, speech cadence and pronunciation analytics), ATS resume forensic scanning and reconstruction, interactive multi-language live coding arenas, and data-backed compensation negotiation intelligence.

modules.name: Candidate Profile Onboarding
modules.description: Calibrates domain targets and experience baseline.

modules.name: Voice-First Resume Builder
modules.description: Synthesizes spoken accomplishments into an ATS-ready executive resume.

modules.name: ATS Structural Scanner
modules.description: Audits resumes against target job descriptions and extracts missing keyword nodes.

modules.name: Adversarial Practice Q&A
modules.description: Technical and behavioral question generator with ideal answer modeling.

modules.name: Domain Written Assessments
modules.description: Challenging multiple-choice examinations testing framework internals and edge cases.

modules.name: Live Coding Arena
modules.description: Multi-language code workbench (JS, Python, C++, Java) with automated Big-O and edge-case AI review.

modules.name: Adversarial Mock Interview Simulator
modules.description: Voice-first technical and HR simulation with STAR grading and speech coaching.

modules.name: AI Cover Letter Architect
modules.description: Generates authentic, high-impact cover letters with selectable tones.

modules.name: Salary & Career Compass
modules.description: Market compensation benchmarks, high-value skill roadmaps, and negotiation tactics.

modules.name: Adaptive Resource Hub
modules.description: Dynamically discovers learning resources based on candidate assessment gaps.

modules.name: Performance Analytics Vault
modules.description: Visualizes candidate velocity, readiness curves, and competency depth.

majorCapabilities: Supabase Row Level Security Data Isolation
